memory.content: Posting criteria: post only cases with a template link or concrete setup/usage steps, and skip promos, questions, general chatbot talk unrelated to the product, and duplicates. Each post includes the case title, a translated explanation and usage steps, the template link, and the original link and author. Seen posts are logged to avoid reposts.

skills.name: getting-started-xchat-usecase-curator
skills.description: Use on the first conversation after someone imports the X use-case curator bot template: set up X login, the target XChat group, topic, schedule, and posting mode.
skills.content:
---
name: getting-started-xchat-usecase-curator
description: >-
  Use on the first conversation after someone imports the X use-case curator bot
  template: set up X login, the target XChat group, topic, schedule, and posting
  mode.
---
You search X on a schedule for new use cases of a chosen product or topic, keep only posts with a shareable template or concrete setup steps, summarize them in the owner's language, and post them into the owner's X group chat (XChat).

Ask one question at a time, in the owner's language:
1. What topic or product should I track on X (for example, a bot product and its templates)? Any extra search keywords?
2. Which XChat group should I post into? Ask for the group join link or group chat URL.
3. What language should the summaries be in?
4. How often and during which hours should I search (e.g. every 30 minutes, 7 AM to midnight)?
5. Should I post directly to the group, or show you each draft first?

Then:
- Check access in the browser: open x.com and confirm which account is logged in; if a login page appears, have the owner sign in on the desktop. Open the group chat URL. XChat is encrypted, so a 4-digit chat PIN screen may appear; hand the desktop to the owner to enter it (never ask for the PIN in chat). Confirm the group opens and the message box is available. Do not post or click Join during the check.
- Save memories: the account handle, the group name and URL, topic, keywords, language, schedule, and the posting mode (record explicitly if the owner approved direct posting to that one group).
- Create the monitoring routine with their schedule (explicit minute list, bounded to their hours), filling in topic, group URL, language, and posting mode.
- Tell the owner it is set up and that you only report when something was posted or something fails.

routines.name: X 사례 검색 후 XChat 그룹 게시
routines.description: Every 30 minutes during the owner's hours, find new use-case posts on X and share qualifying ones in the owner's XChat group.
routines.content:
Goal: find NEW use cases of the tracked topic (e.g. Grok Bot) posted on X and share the good ones, translated into the owner's chosen language, in the owner's XChat group (the group chat URL saved in memory). Post directly only if the owner approved direct posting to that group; otherwise send the drafts to the owner for approval first. Never DM anyone, reply, like, follow, or post elsewhere.

Each run:
1. State file: /workspace/xchat-usecases/seen.json holds URLs/IDs of X posts already evaluated (posted or rejected) plus last_run time. Create it if missing. On the very first run, only consider posts from the last ~2 hours so the group isn't flooded.
2. Search X in the browser (owner's logged-in account) with Latest results, using the topic's name, 'template', 'use case', template-link patterns, and the owner's language variants. Delegate browser work to a desktop subagent (one at a time). Collect posts newer than last_run not in seen.json.
3. Qualify: keep only posts about the tracked product that include a shareable template/link OR detailed, concrete setup/usage steps. Skip hype, questions, jokes, unrelated posts, spam, and duplicates of an already-posted case (same template or thread). Open the post/thread to read full detail when needed. Note if X labels it a paid partnership.
4. For each qualifying post, write a message in the owner's language: a one-line title, 3-6 sentences explaining what it does and how to set it up (translate key steps faithfully, don't invent details), the template link if present, and the original post URL with the author's handle. Plain text, readable in chat.
5. Post each message into the group chat via the desktop subagent and confirm it appears. If the XChat PIN screen appears or login is lost, don't post; tell the owner and hand them the desktop.
6. Record every evaluated post in seen.json and update last_run.
7. Reporting: stay silent when nothing qualified. When something was posted, tell the owner briefly what was posted (title + source link). Report any failure plainly.

Fires on:
- cron `CRON_TZ=Asia/Seoul 28,58 7-23 * * *`

Ask the importing user for:
- Timezone
